name: pos-table-customer-persistence-ui
title: Fix POS table customer persistence and form clarity
description: Make the POS table customer form explicit, refresh table status immediately after save, and restore all saved customer and schedule fields when reopening the modal.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Root causes: the party-size stepper has no label; the non-order save path does not invoke onUpdated; reserved tables skip TableCustomer hydration even when no active reservation exists; and TableCustomer persists only timeTo, so check-in start time cannot survive reopening.
